assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animated enemy spritesheet for a polished hand-painted fantasy tower-defense mobile game. Subject: small ivory skeleton infantry with chipped sword, blue scarf, iron shoulder plates. Isometric 3/4 top-down camera, facing down toward viewer. Exactly 32 separate full-body animation frames, arranged in a regular 4 columns by 8 rows grid, portrait canvas. Every cell same size. Each sprite occupies at most 65% cell width and 68% cell height with generous FULLY TRANSPARENT gutters on all sides. Feet baseline aligned within every cell. Rows 1-2: eight sequential walking frames. Rows 3-4: eight sequential attack windup, strike and recovery frames. Rows 5-6: eight sequential recoil hurt frames. Rows 7-8: eight sequential collapse and disintegration death frames. Coherent anatomy, same scale, rich painted material and crisp silhouette. Keep entire weapon, cape, limbs and particles fully inside each cell, no overlap or crossing gutters, no cropped features. Actual transparent alpha background, no floor, no shadows outside body, no text, no grid lines, no UI. Movement must visibly change between consecutive frames. Large empty gutters are essential; no extra sprites.
